presets.label: Station cabin
presets.plain: About 21% oxygen at 14.7 psi, like air at sea level
presets.tolerance_plain: Counts a test within 1 point of oxygen and 5% of the pressure.
presets.source: PSI-20 (ACME BRE) record, objective 1: "NASA-considered atmosphere for human space missions will be examined: 14.7 psia, 21 % oxygen: 10.2 psia, 26.5 %; and 8.2 psia, 34 % oxygen." Also the challenge page: Earth's sea-level pressure is 14.7 psi.

presets.label: Exploration atmosphere
presets.plain: 30% oxygen or more, at 10.2 psi or less
presets.tolerance_plain: Used exactly as the source states it: no tolerance added.
presets.source: docs/00-challenge-description.md (challenge page): "likely 30% oxygen or more at 10.2 psi or less", for the Moon base and pressurized rovers.

presets.label: 26.5% oxygen at 10.2 psi
presets.plain: 26.5% oxygen at 10.2 psi, a NASA-considered cabin atmosphere
presets.tolerance_plain: Counts a test within 1 point of oxygen and 5% of the pressure.
presets.source: PSI-20 (ACME BRE) record, objective 1: "NASA-considered atmosphere for human space missions will be examined: 14.7 psia, 21 % oxygen: 10.2 psia, 26.5 %; and 8.2 psia, 34 % oxygen."

presets.label: 34% oxygen at 8.2 psi

presets.label: High oxygen
presets.plain: 40% oxygen or more, at any pressure
presets.tolerance_plain: Used exactly as the source states it: no tolerance added.
presets.source: docs/04-researchers-guide-iss-combustion.md: the ISS droplet hardware (MDCA) and SoFIE run up to 40% oxygen. A stress case, not a planned cabin.
